name: button
title: Button
description: A compound button component with variants, modes, sizes, and polymorphic icon support. Uses namespace exports: Button.Root, Button.Icon.

docs.lead: A compound button component with variants, modes, sizes, and polymorphic icon support.
docs.usage:
import * as Button from "@/components/ui/button"

<Button.Root variant="primary" mode="filled">
  <Button.Icon as={MailIcon} />
  Send Email
</Button.Root>

examples.title: Primary Variant
examples.description: The primary variant uses the brand color for main call-to-action buttons.
examples.code:
<Button.Root variant="primary" mode="filled">Get Started</Button.Root>
<Button.Root variant="primary" mode="stroke">Get Started</Button.Root>
<Button.Root variant="primary" mode="lighter">Get Started</Button.Root>
<Button.Root variant="primary" mode="ghost">Get Started</Button.Root>

examples.title: Neutral Variant
examples.description: The neutral variant uses grayscale colors for secondary actions.
examples.code:
<Button.Root variant="neutral" mode="filled">Learn More</Button.Root>
<Button.Root variant="neutral" mode="stroke">Learn More</Button.Root>
<Button.Root variant="neutral" mode="lighter">Learn More</Button.Root>
<Button.Root variant="neutral" mode="ghost">Learn More</Button.Root>

examples.title: Error Variant
examples.description: The error variant for destructive actions.
examples.code:
<Button.Root variant="error" mode="filled">Try Again</Button.Root>
<Button.Root variant="error" mode="stroke">Try Again</Button.Root>
<Button.Root variant="error" mode="lighter">Try Again</Button.Root>
<Button.Root variant="error" mode="ghost">Try Again</Button.Root>

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Buttons come in multiple sizes across all modes.

examples.title: With Icon
examples.description: Use Button.Icon with the `as` prop for polymorphic icon rendering.

examples.title: Full Width
examples.description: Buttons can stretch to fill their container with a className override.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Renders as child element using Radix Slot

api.name: Button.Icon
api.description: Polymorphic icon container that receives variant props from Button.Root.

props.name: as
props.description: The element or component to render as
